🔥 555 – Viene un cambio grande, inevitable y sagrado. No te resistas. Tu alma lo pidió. Tu cuerpo lo está sintiendo.
🕊️ 777 – Estás alineada con lo divino. Confía en tu camino, aunque no todo sea claro hoy. Este es un portal de sabiduría para ti.
💫 888 – Abundancia en camino. Tu energía está lista para recibir. Deja de esconder tu brillo. Eres canal de expansión.
🌟 1111 – Pensamiento = creación. Cuida lo que piensas hoy: es semilla directa del mañana que estás invocando.

¿Cuál número te tocó?
Déjalo en los comentarios 🦋

description:
Wakil Presiden (Wapres) Gibran Rakabuming Raka menjadi perhatian publik setelah mengunggah video monolog di saluran YouTube resminya. 

Dalam video tersebut Gibran membahas peluang besar Indonesia terkait puncak bonus demografi yang diprediksi terjadi pada 2030 hingga 2045. 

Ia menekankan pentingnya memanfaatkan momen tersebut di tengah tantangan global.

Video monolog Gibran menuai beragam reaksi dari masyarakat. Ada yang mengkritik gaya penyampaiannya, namun tidak sedikit pula yang mendukung. 

Pembelaan terhadap Gibran juga datang dari pihak Istana yang menilai bentuk komunikasi tersebut sah-sah saja selama pesan tersampaikan dengan baik.

description:
People ask me what I think of makeup a lot, and I'm not really in the business of telling anyone what they should or shouldn't do as far as beauty practices go.

That said, I know a lot of you don't feel as free to be seen in public without makeup on as you deserve and I have some tips which might help with that.

If you've ever wondered why some women seem to be ok with going without makeup or a filter when you might find that really difficult, these are some of the ideas that have helped me.

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖

નોંધ: અમારી કોઈ પણ પોસ્ટ થી કોઈ પણ ધર્મ કે લોકો ની લાગણી દુભાવવા માટે નથી.

અમારી પોસ્ટ માં મુકવા માં આવતી અમુક ફોટો કાલ્પનિક અથવા તો સમજાવવા માટે હોય છે.
.
અમારી અમુક પોસ્ટ માં ટાઇપિંગ માં કે કોઈ પણ રીતે ભૂલ ચુક થઈ જતી હોય છે તો એના માટે તમારો નાનો ભાઈ સમજી ને માફ કરી દેવું. 
.
અમે અમારા તરફ થી પૂરો પ્રયાસ કરશું કે તમને બેસ્ટ નોલેજ મળે.

🚫 Warring 🚫

કોઈએ પણ અભદ્ર ટિપ્પણી કરવી નહીં, જો એવું કરશો તો એની જવાબદારી તમારી રહેશે એ શખ્સ ઉપર શકત કાર્યવાહી કરવામાં આવશે.

Polícia Civil de Formosa do Oeste Prende Suspeitos de Homicídio em Jesuítas

*Formosa do Oeste, 18 de abril de 2025* - A Polícia Civil de Formosa do Oeste realizou uma operação bem-sucedida na tarde desta sexta-feira, prendendo os dois suspeitos do homicídio ocorrido na madrugada de hoje, 18 de abril de 2025, em Jesuítas.

Um atirador desferiu disparos de arma de fogo na vítima e fugiu do local. Com a rápida ação da Polícia Civil, o autor dos disparos foi identificado e localizado. Durante as investigações, foi descoberta a participação de outro indivíduo no crime, que também foi localizado e preso.

*Próximos Passos:*

Os dois suspeitos serão encaminhados à Justiça para responderem pelas acusações.

Da Redação: Com informações da Polícia Civil com Portal Região (PC)

The secret to motivation and delayed gratification is….

Choosing to know that you will be able to do the thing or achieve the goal. Choosing to know that it is possible at the very least! 

Lmk what you think! Have you thought about it in this way before? I know it took me a long time to learn this perspective.

We’re redefining freedom for our communities through the power of collaboration. Our strategic partnership with Growing Real Alternatives Everywhere (GRAE) has been pivotal in clearing over $750,000 in fines and fees through our warrant clinics across the country for years. These clinics have given Black and marginalized communities the opportunity to clear their legal records without the threat of arrest—restoring not only their legal standing but also their peace of mind. Together, we are continuing our fight for justice, where clearing warrants is just the beginning. 

This month, we expand our impact by teaming up with the @naacp_ldf for a clinic in Selma, Alabama. This work is about more than removing legal obstacles—it’s about reclaiming freedom, restoring dignity, and offering hope. It’s about dismantling the systemic inequities that disproportionately affect Black communities, ensuring that no one lives in fear of an unjust system. Help us continue our work: bit.ly/bvmclinics #WarrantClinic #CommunityCare #ReimagingFreedom

Una de las ferias navideñas más emblemáticas y antiguas de Catalunya 🎄 ¡No te la pierdas! 🔐

📍 Ubicación: En el pintoresco pueblo de Espinelves, en la comarca de Osona, dentro de la provincia de Girona. La Fira se despliega a lo largo de sus encantadoras calles.

ℹ️ La Fira de l’Avet de Espinelves es una celebración tradicional que tiene lugar cada diciembre. Reconocida como una de las ferias navideñas más destacadas de Catalunya, este año celebra su 43ª edición 🎄

En esta feria encontrarás una amplia variedad de abetos y productos navideños, desde adornos y decoraciones hasta artesanía local y delicias gastronómicas típicas de la Navidad.

Además de la venta, la feria ofrece un sinfín de actividades para toda la familia: conciertos de música navideña, representaciones teatrales, talleres para niños y adultos, y otras propuestas para sumergirse en el espíritu navideño.

🗓️ Fechas: Del 30 de noviembre al 8 de diciembre
🕒 Horario:
	•	Festivos: 10:00h a 19:30h
	•	Laborales: 10:00h a 17:00h
🎫 Entrada libre y gratuita
🅿️ Parking: 4€ por coche

Un video publicado en TikTok por Rodolfo Ramírez, militante del PSUV y director general de la Alcaldía del municipio Santiago Mariño, estado Aragua, ha generado indignación en redes sociales. En la grabación, Ramírez describe abiertamente la supuesta labor de los jefes de calles, afirmando que deben conocer quiénes se han mudado, quién ha fallecido, quién está enfermo y cuántos votos "duros" o "blandos" hay en su comunidad.

Usuarios en redes han calificado sus palabras como un ejemplo descarado del control social ejercido por el régimen de Nicolás Maduro. La indignación aumentó por las expresiones faciales de quienes lo acompañaban en el video, reflejando incomodidad ante su discurso.

Aunque el video fue eliminado, su contenido sigue circulando, avivando el debate sobre la vigilancia política en Venezuela y el uso de estructuras comunitarias como mecanismos de control ciudadano.

- 喝奶的姿势变化多样
- 产后接近三个月开始掉發，起初沒什麼在乎，但慢慢掉了一個月後發現額頭前兩旁怎麼空空的…快快去買生髮水🙃
- 冲凉的姿态也是多样化，声音越教越大声（各种音效都来了） 
- 手伸高的力度越來越穩了，但為什麼你是四月齡寶寶怎麼還不翻身呢？🍼是肚子太大個重
- 從小用布擦臉就特別興奮，好像蠻喜歡冷水😅
- 来自娘亲的恶作剧😏三角形飯糰@亲爹的梳頭髮（飛機頭）
- 頭髮長長了：但只有前面比較特殊（長得比較快），旁邊後面不知道是不是睡的姿勢影響頭髮生長不出來 🔎
- 同事介紹的充氣椅子（之前還考慮要不要買）買了也比較好，可以自己坐起來，不用咱們抱著（天氣太熱，容易出汗）austin 下午自己靜靜的坐著看Mr bean 
- 收拾衣櫥時發現朋友給的寶寶女裝，趕緊安排一個：爸爸的女兒夢❣️
- 模仿能力挺强的
- 翻身只放一半，又不翻完🤦🏻‍♀️
- 淘寶買的帽子和新年衣❤️现在买衣服越买越大件👕
-下午冲完凉，习惯了，看到小杯子特别兴奋，可以喝甜甜的肥仔水
- 无意间发现爸爸亲亲你（一脸嫌弃的样子）赶紧记录下来🤣
- 爸爸哄你睡覺，哄到爸爸自己都投降了🤦🏻‍♀️
- 開始玩舌頭和吞口水 
-萬聖節寶寶
- 來自外公的愛 （拍打嗝的姿勢）

description:
Malaysia menyuarakan kebimbangan berlakunya sekatan eksport terhadap barangan perubatan susulan keputusan Amerika Syarikat (AS) mengenakan tarif tinggi terhadap produk dari negara ini.

Menteri Kesihatan, Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad berkata, beliau baru sahaja menghadiri mesyuarat bersama Perdana Menteri, Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim dan beberapa menteri kanan bagi membincangkan kesan tindakan dikenali sebagai 'reaksi Presiden Trump' itu.

"Saya harus katakan, kita benar-benar marah. Sekatan eksport melibatkan ubat-ubatan bernilai AS$36 bilion adalah langkah yang menekan negara-negara sedang membangun seperti Malaysia.

"Walaupun peranti perubatan dikecualikan, namun yang menjadi masalah besar ialah ketidaktentuan dalam rundingan harga," katanya ketika ditemui pada Rumah Terbuka dan pembukaan Hospital KPJ Kuala Selangor, hari ini

Dr Dzulkefly menjelaskan, tindakan itu merupakan ancaman besar terhadap sistem perdagangan dan pelaburan global yang seharusnya bersifat adil serta berkecuali.

Presiden dan Pengarah Urusan KPJ Healthcare Berhad, Chin Keat Chyuan berkata, pihaknya terus berpandukan arahan kerajaan dan Kementerian Kesihatan dalam menangani isu tersebut.

Memimpin coffee morning SKPD, Kabag dan Para Camat se Kabupaten Gowa di pekan terakhir tahun 2024. Sekaligus membicarakan setiap persoalan yang ada di wilayah kerja masing-masing untuk mencari solusi bersama. Setelah itu, Sy menerima audiens Tim 9 (Tim Perumus) Majelis Pemangku Adat Tinggi Kerajaan Gowa, lalu menerima audiens panitia pelaksana event Gowa Run.

Serta mendengarkan arahan dari Bapak Presiden @prabowo. Sorenya, ngopi bersama Ibu Bupati Gowa terpilih @husniahtalenrang. Tetap semangat, salam sehat untuk kita semuanya💪🙏

Quem diria que essas aventuras, que marcaram tanto, estariam acessíveis na palma da mão hoje em dia? 🤔
 
Essa mágica acontece graças aos apps de emuladores, que recriam esses consoles antigos no ambiente mobile. 📱 E claro, a evolução dos aparelhos é fundamental!
 
A capacidade de processamento e as telas de smartphones modernos, como o Poco X7, são o que dão vida a essa nostalgia e permitem carregar essa biblioteca histórica no bolso. ✨
 
Agora me conta: se só pudesse escolher UM desses pra jogar no emulador hoje, qual seria? 👇 Deixa nos comentários!

description:
Identitas 10 pelaku perusakan di acara diskusi sejumlah tokoh di Kemang, Mampang Prapatan, Jakarta Selatan, pada Sabtu (28/9/2024) telah dikantongi pihak kepolisian.

Video aksi pembubaran dan perusakan di lokasi diskusi beredar viral di media sosial.

“Ada 10 orang. Sudah kita identifikasi dan ketahui nama-nama pelakunya,” kata Kapolres Metro Jakarta Selatan Kombes Polisi Ade Rahmat Idnal kepada wartawan.

Acara diskusi tersebut dihadiri sejumlah tokoh seperti mantan Ketua Umum PP Muhammadiyah Din Syamsuddin dan pakar hukum tata negara Refly Harun.

description: This #WorldCarFreeDay, leave the car behind and pedal ahead with ZERO effort! 🚴‍♀️💨#OMGIndia

Still can’t believe it, I swam with SHARKS! Yep, actual, real-life, toothy, ocean-roaming sharks. My 10-year-old self is high-fiving me so hard right now. Honestly, it feels like a dream... I keep pinching myself just to make sure I didn’t imagine it (also, ouch).

If you’re heading to the Maldives, take this as your sign: do not just park yourself at the resort all day with a coconut in hand. Sure, that’s nice... but the real magic? 

It’s out there in the water, waiting to scare the fins off you, in the best way possible.

Adrenaline? Through the roof. Heart? Might’ve skipped a few beats. Regrets? Absolutely none.

Now, who’s ready to dive into their own wild adventure? (But seriously... don’t tell my mom I did this.)🤪🤙🏻

description:
The new XL Supreme trees from @starkbros produce fruit YEARS before smaller options!

I’m so excited to add these cherry trees to the orchard back by our blackberry patch. I chose Emporer Francis, Black Tartarian, and Van sweet cherries in their new XL Supreme Grow Bags. The larger size contains a more advanced root system so you don’t spend the better part of a decade waiting for fruit! 🤤 🍒 The root bag it’s shipped in also helps the roots air prune themselves so they don’t become tangled and root bound. It results in a healthier tree and reduces transplant shock! Just make sure you pop them out of it before you plant.

It’s not my first time ordering from Stark Brothers, and I continue to be impressed. I mean, these came out of the box with blossoms. 😱 Stark Bros has such a great selection of berries, trees, and beyond. I added some asparagus from them this spring!

Are you planting any fruit trees or berries this year?

description:
🛠️На родниковских очистных идут ремонтно-восстановительные работы

Индустриальный парк «Родники» опубликовал видео с биологических очистных сооружений. Сейчас там проводят ремонтно-восстановительные мероприятия. Освобождают ото льда, воды, ила и грязи отстойники, готовятся к работам по герметизации и бетонированию стен, после чего начнется монтаж металлоконструкций.

«Готовим дополнительную цепочку для очистки сточных вод, чтобы разгрузить имеющиеся мощности и получить возможность получения большего объёма сточных вод на очистных сооружениях», — отметил Сергей Завьялов, генеральный директор «УК ИП «Родники».

Отметим, на днях в Родники и Фурманов по жалобам местных жителей на нарушения при эксплуатации местных очистных сооружений выезжали специалисты Росприроднадзора. Из Юкши и Шачи взяли пробы воды, по результатам их анализа будет дана оценка соблюдению предприятиями требований природоохранного законодательства.

Diriwayatkan dari ‘Abdurrahman bin Ghanm al-Asy’ari, dia berkata, “Abu ‘Amir atau Abu Malik al-Asy’ari Radhiyallahu anhu telah menceritakan kepadaku, demi Allâh, dia tidak berdusta kepadaku, dia telah mendengar Rasûlullâh Shallallahu ‘alaihi wa sallam bersabda,

لَـيَـكُوْنَـنَّ مِنْ أُمَّـتِـيْ أَقْوَامٌ يَـسْتَحِلُّوْنَ الْـحِرَ ، وَالْـحَرِيْرَ ، وَالْـخَمْرَ ، وَالْـمَعَازِفَ. وَلَيَنْزِلَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ إِلَـى جَنْبِ عَلَمٍ يَرُوْحُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَارِحَةٍ لَـهُمْ ، يَأْتِيْهِمْ –يَعْنِيْ الْفَقِيْرَ- لِـحَاجَةٍ فَيَـقُوْلُوْنَ : ارْجِعْ إِلَيْنَا غَدًا ، فَـيُـبَـيِـّـتُـهُـمُ اللهُ وَيَـضَعُ الْعَلَمَ وَيَـمْسَـخُ آخَرِيْنَ قِرَدَةً وَخَنَازِيْرَ إِلَـى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.

‘Sungguh, benar-benar akan ada di kalangan ummatku sekelompok orang yang menghalalkan kemaluan (zina), sutera, khamr (minuman keras), dan alat-alat musik. Dan beberapa kelompok orang sungguh akan singgah di lereng sebuah gunung dengan binatang ternak mereka, lalu seseorang mendatangi mereka  -yaitu orang fakir- untuk suatu keperluan, lalu mereka berkata, ‘Kembalilah kepada kami besok hari.’ Kemudian Allâh mendatangkan siksaan kepada mereka dan menimpakan gunung kepada mereka serta Allâh mengubah sebagian dari mereka menjadi kera dan babi sampai hari Kiamat.’

TAKHRIJ HADITS

al-Bukhâri secara mu’allaq[1] dengan lafazh jazm (pasti) dalam Shahîh–nya (no. 5590). Lihat Fat-hul Bâri (X/51),
Ibnu Hibbân (no. 6719-at-Ta’lîqâtul Hisân),
al-Baihaqi dalam Sunan-nya (X/221),

description:
시켜먹지 마세요!

✔️팟타이
쌀국수면,냉동새우,보리새우(건새우),양파,대파,다진마늘,숙주,계란,참치액,굴소스,스리라차 소스,알룰로스or설탕,레몬즙or식초

✨팬에 식용유 3스푼정도 넣고 대파 한뼘 정도,양파 작은거 1개(큰거는 1/2개),다진마늘 반스푼 넣고 볶아줍니다
✨파,마늘 향좀 올라오면 냉동새우 6미, 보리새우 3스푼 다져서 넣고 한번 더 볶아서 재료 한쪽으로 밀어줍니다
✨계란 2알 스크램블해주고 완전히 익혔을때 전체적으로 볶아줍니다
✨찬물에 30분 이상 불려둔 쌀국수면넣고 참치액,굴소스,스리라차 소스,설탕이나 알룰로스 한스푼 넣어 볶아줍니다
✨면이 덜 불어서 잘 안익거나 하면 물을 조금씩 추가해서 면이 잘 익을때까지 볶아줍니다
✨마무리로 숙주 한줌 레몬즙 1/2스푼(없으면 식초)넣고 쎈불에 1분정도 빠르게 볶아주면 완성!

집 근처에 팟타이 맛집이 없다면 아무데서나 배달 시키지 말고 한번만 만들어 보세요!
피쉬소스 없이도 가능하고 오히려 더 한국적인맛이라 또 드시고 싶으실걸요..?!😎

description:
Zapominanie o ex nie jest łatwe, ale można przyspieszyć ten proces, dbając o siebie i zmieniając perspektywę. Oto kilka skutecznych sposobów:

1. Odetnij kontakt: Usuń numer, przestań obserwować w mediach społecznościowych i nie zaglądaj na jego profil. To trudne, ale bardzo pomaga w procesie zapominania.

2. Pozbądź się pamiątek: Usuń zdjęcia, prezenty i wszystko, co przypomina o byłym. Jeśli nie jesteś gotowa wyrzucić, schowaj je na razie w pudełku.

3. Zajmij myśli czymś nowym: Spróbuj nowego hobby, zacznij ćwiczyć albo zrób coś, co zawsze odkładałaś na później.

4. Rozmawiaj o tym: Wygadanie się przyjaciołom lub bliskim pomoże wyrzucić z siebie emocje i spojrzeć na sytuację z innej perspektywy.

5. Zadbaj o siebie: Skup się na swoim zdrowiu fizycznym i psychicznym – ćwiczenia, zdrowa dieta i chwile relaksu naprawdę pomagają.

6. Unikaj idealizowania: Przypomnij sobie powody rozstania i sytuacje, które nie były takie kolorowe.

7. Daj sobie czas: To naturalne, że na początku jest trudno. Każdy dzień bez kontaktu to krok w stronę wolności emocjonalnej.

8. Spotykaj się z ludźmi: Nawet jeśli nie szukasz nowej relacji, spędzanie czasu z innymi pomoże oderwać się od wspomnień.

Jeśli potrzebujesz wsparcia albo chcesz pogadać o tym, co Cię dręczy, jestem tutaj! DM 📥

description:
繼三月來找姊姊滑雙板之後
萬萬想不到十二月竟然來挑戰單板
呃
回想三月那時候
姊姊只用了2小時就帶我上纜車
（單板的成就感來的很快🤣🤣）

今天深深感受到體力有多爛
單板有多累
（不斷的跌倒再爬起來把binding脫掉再重新穿進去
無限重複了不知道幾次
中午放飯的時候真的是很想回家
還是硬把下午的課也熬完了）
每滑幾下就會不自覺用屁股降落🙂‍↕️🙂‍↕️

下課累得像條狗⋯⋯⋯
現在回到家洗完澡 大腿痛的跟什麼一樣
今天才day one
我怎麼已經想要直接回台灣了呢( ꐦ ¯−¯ )
到底為什麼沒事要學單板呢
（心裡的os 吶喊）（究竟要跌倒幾次之後才會變厲害一點呢？？？讓我們繼續看下去）

1. Morning drink - AMLA JUICE WITH CHIA SEEDS

Empty stomach I take Amla juice with soaked chia seeds and some pink salt to support good gut health and replenish electrolytes in body. 

2. Breakfast - EGG TOAST 

Using 2 boiled eggs, some guacamole with 2 slices of sourdough makes for a quick and perfect breakfast option

3. Snack 

Post 1hr of lunch to curb those sweet cravings, I generally eat some fruits but today I blended some mango cubes with yogurt and sprinkled some chia seeds for snack 

4. Lunch 

For lunch, I always want lots of veggies and protein and generally I take rice as well so i can keep dinner lighter here I had some herbed rice + avocado + carrots and 100g grill paneer. 

5. Post evening workout I had my 1 scoop whey protein nicely blended in 1 glass water 

6. Dinner :- To keep it light and balanced , I had 80g grilled chicken with steamed carrots and cauliflower and chopped cucumber .

PS: If you caught our Volterra story while we were there… stay tuned, we’ll be revealing more soon! 👀

description:
Your behaviour around tiger sharks should be exactly how we instruct you to do so 🤘 

you have to stay big and strong, if a tiger shark approaches you have to hold your position look them in the eye and and be calm. As a dive instructor and someone who works with people, I know, as do other dive guides, which person or people will be nervous and that’s ok. Generally speaking a shark won’t look at a group of people and know which one feels nervous. But of course if you act like you’re nervous then sure they will know 😅Sharks do a thing called parallel swimming, it’s them sizing things up to see what it is. They all do it. This is why we say don’t splash, don’t cower into a ball don’t make sudden movements

Seja um embaixador do Projeto Saturn!🪐🔭

O Projeto Saturn tem como principal missão difundir o uso de telescópios no contexto educativo, tornando-os instrumentos acessíveis e integrados ao cotidiano escolar e aos projetos comunitários como forma de estímulo ao tema.

O programa de embaixadores foi criado com o intuito de tornar o projeto verdadeiramente universal, viabilizando uma versão gratuita de baixo custo telescópio Saturn para jovens ao redor do mundo, especialmente em contextos de vulnerabilidade social. 

Ser um embaixador é, antes de tudo, abraçar uma causa global: a de semear fascínio pelo universo, como instrumento de transformação social, intelectual e emocional. 

Apoie esse projeto e seja um embaixador! Nos envie um direct para mais informações 🚀

description:
Let’s go to Ballarat🦘🤍

📍Ballarat wildlife park 
We have koala encounter that’s we got a super closer look to the active koala. All  animals are super friendly. And if you lucky there is a quokka hidden inside the koala area. 

📍Meigas Tapas 
The lunch we went to make a tapas that serves authentic Spanish food with lots of umami flavour. The Gambas Al Pil Pil (garlic prawn) is a must order!!

📍Sovereign Hill
Recommended to go a bit earlier as there is a lot to explore in the park. We got to see how to make a gold bar and get to do some gold digging from the mine. 

📍Peasant 
If you looking for simple and nice food Peasant is the place for you ! They do really comfortable and simple food 🍲 with 5 courses for $95, only opens on the Friday and Saturday night. The rest of the night the restaurant is called higher society.

Thank for all the amazing experiences Ballarat will definitely come back. ❤️

description:
🤼‍♀️ Los usuarios de las redes sociales le dieron un “finisher” a la Secretaria de Educación Federal, Linda McMahon, por la carta que envió a Harvard.

📩 La funcionaria exigió que la universidad deje de pedir fondos federales y los acusó de fallas sistémicas en liderazgo y políticas sobre antisemitismo.

🖍️ Los usuarios de redes sociales no tardaron en destruir la carta y, usando tinta roja como los maestros, le corrigieron los errores ortográficos y gramáticos.

🎓 Harvard confirmó haber recibido la carta y acusó al gobierno de intentar ejercer “control impropio y sin precedentes”. La universidad afirmó que seguirá cumpliendo la ley, promoviendo diversidad de pensamiento y combatiendo el antisemitismo.

Fuente: Hindustan Times

description:
A 14-year-old NRI student, Siddharth Nandyala, has developed an AI-powered app that can detect heart issues in just seven seconds, drawing praise from Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu and Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan.

The app, called CircadiaV, was tested at Guntur Government General Hospital (GGH), where it demonstrated real-world potential in identifying cardiac conditions quickly and accurately.

“This 14-year-old has made detecting heart-related problems easier! I am absolutely delighted to meet Siddharth Nandyala, a young AI enthusiast from Dallas and the world’s youngest AI-certified professional, holding certifications from both Oracle and ARM. Siddharth’s app, Circadian AI, is a medical breakthrough that can detect heart-related issues within seconds," CM Naidu wrote in a post on X.

Naidu also promised full government support for continued research into artificial intelligence. Deputy CM Kalyan also commended Siddharth for his vision and success at such a young age.

CircadiaV uses advanced algorithms to analyze patient data and flag potential heart ailments, reducing the time needed for detection and diagnosis.

Thank you all for the response to my upcoming aerial hammock retreat with @flykaravek ♥️

Initially designed for beginners, the majority of enquiries have come from advanced beginners to intermediate aerialists. To accommodate this interest, I’ve decided to open this aerial hammock retreat to Pre-Intermediate students, with a prerequisite of crossback invert 💪🏻

Dates: 15-20 December 2025 

Get ready to elevate your practice with over 20 hours of training and aerial experiences. We’ll indulge in delicious Thai cuisine and explore the rich culture and stunning sights of Chiang Rai 🌿

But that’s not all! You’ll have the rare opportunity to connect with majestic elephants at a sanctuary and even fly alongside them 🐘 We’ll also visit an enchanting flower field in full bloom, exclusive to this time of year 🌸, and take it to the skies for an unforgettable hot air balloon aerial experience 🎈

Special early bird pricing is available until 1 May 2025.

Spots are limited, so don’t wait! Reach out for the full info pack or click the link in my bio to register 🪄

description:
MUST-TRY OMAKASE EXPERIENCE IN CBUS 🍣✨

We had the chance to check out @haru.omakase, and let’s just say—we were blown away. Their exclusive five-course tasting menu was next-level, with every piece of fish being literally the best we’ve ever had. Since their menu rotates every six weeks, each visit brings a fresh and exciting experience.

Executive Chef Yudi Makassau (previously of Nobu Miami and Mandrake) is a master of his craft, blending timeless sushi artistry with bold, modern creativity. Each course is served directly to you at the intimate omakase counter, where Chef Yudi personally explains every detail behind the ingredients and preparation—making the meal even more special.

The ambiance? Just as stunning as the food. The interior perfectly showcases traditional Japanese cuisine with a contemporary flair, setting the stage for an unforgettable dining experience. For those looking to elevate their meal even further, The Premium Tour currently offers exclusive selections you won’t want to miss.

We also opted for the $45 beverage pairing, and every sake and wine was thoughtfully selected to enhance each course.

With limited counter seating at 5:00pm, 6:45pm, and 8:30pm, reservations are a must—this is truly a one-of-a-kind experience you don’t want to miss. We loved everything from start to finish and are already dreaming about our next tour!

#台中美食 西屯區
燒肉風間 福科三店✨ #台中新開幕
🥩 Esoteric雙人/三人套餐
地址：台中市西屯區福科路158號
營業時間：11:30～24:00
電話：04-24621856
燒肉風間在台中西屯開了第三間分店‼️
鄰近中科商圈在福科路上
這家的套餐肉品很豐盛🤩
和牛套餐可以吃到好多品項
好愛月見紐約客 吃起來肉質超嫩的🥩
配上生蛋非常順口 還有牛舌也是必吃的
很推加價升級極厚切的牛舌
烤起來又香又Q 一吃就愛上
和牛牛排好大一塊 代烤服務很棒
五分熟度剛剛好 鮮嫩多汁
米飯很推和牛海膽舒肥蛋拌飯🍚
料多味美  還有日本和牛韃靼
也是配上海膽 吃起來也很過癮👍
升級的海鮮也很浮誇
巨人海鮮 大蝦&干貝都超大 食材很新鮮
想吃燒肉來這就對了
生日禮✨

🅰️ 當日壽星活動：只要壽星當天來店用餐
就可以參加當日的壽星活動
最大獎是當天的餐點全部由店家招待唷
🅱️ 當月壽星活動：加入燒肉風間Line好友
於用餐時出示主頁 當月壽星兌換活動
與有效證件 即可獲得當月壽星兌換禮【招牌奶油啤酒】

準備ばかりして気づけば数ヶ月。
「韓国ひとり旅がしてみたい！」
そう思ったのに何ひとつ動けてなかった…

でも、ある日ふと思った。
「もぅ行ったほうが早くない？」

実際に行ってみたら
あれこれ悩んでたことが嘘みたいに
するするっと全部できた。

「完璧な準備よりまず一歩」

ほんの少しの勇気で
景色も、自分も、未来も変わり始める。

タイミングなんていつだって
やりたいと思ったその瞬間！

description:
Sharing how much we enjoyed @sevencornersofficial  @crowneplazamanilagalleria  lunch buffet yesterday!
*
Our discerning boys who are self-appointed ( lol) buffet experts were impressed at the quality of the spread and can’t stop raving about the ff
❤️ Melt in your mouth roast beef and delicious mash
❤️ butter garlic shrimps & mussels freshly pan fried in fiery glory while u watch
❤️ premium quality sushi & sahimi
❤️ fresh greens at the salad selection
❤️ delicious desserts
❤️ freshly made Bibingka n Puto bumbong 
❤️ Indian food
❤️ Chinese food
❤️ assorted bread 
❤️ charcuterie
*
They also loved how calm and peaceful the vibe was and how attentive the servers were🥰
*
Rates 

Monday-Sunday Breaskfast - Php 1,700.00 nett per person
Monday-Sunday Lunch - Php 2700.00 nett per person
Monday-Sunday Dinner - Php 2900.00 nett per person

Kids Discount;
5 years old below - Free of Charge
6-12 years old - half of the rate

Operating Hours:

Breakfast
Monday to Friday - 6:00am - 10:00am
Saturday and Sunday - 6:30am - 10:30am

Lunch
Monday to Friday - 11:30am - 2:30pm
Saturday and Sunday -  12:00pm - 3:00pm

Dinner 
Daily - 6:00pm - 10:00pm
*
Absolutely a must try ❤️

안녕하세요 ?!?~
소식이 마이 늦었쬬요~~🥲 죄송합니당~~^^;

마음이 조급해지고 있어요

2주이상 계속 되니  넘 괴롭.....
안먹으면 힘이없고 먹으면 계속...... 아시져? ㅋ😔

그래도 우야둥둥 힘을 내어 
마지막 패킹에 박차를 가하고 있습니다 
이번주 안으로는 발송할수 있을듯해요

description:
Unboxing dengan ilmu neuroscience. Emang cuma ilmu hitam aja yang bisa bikin benda terbang dan muter-muter?

Kalau kata Bee, seorang Neuroscientist di buku ini, cinta itu hanyalah peningkatan aktivitas di area ventral tegmental otak (area dekat Substantia Nigra di otak tengah). Peningkatan dopamin (sebuah neurotransmitter yang berpengaruh terhadap perasaan bahagia hingga adiksi, serta kelancaran gerakan motorik) dan kebetulan kimia. Jadi... apakah cinta itu benar ada atau hanya sebatas interaksi kimia?

Buku : Love On The Brain
Penulis :  @alihazelwood
Diterjemahkan oleh Penerbit GPU.

Excited bangettt baca buku romance tentang orang-orang kutu buku ini. Apalagi Bee adalah neuroengineer, jadi selain mempelajari ilmu tentang otak dia juga bisa coding ke mesin. And she works for NASA! Fix ini tropes idaman para kutu buku 🤣🤣🤣

Almost every huge change in this space ( the faux lime-washed walls & ceiling, the contrasting black doors, the dark brick feature wall) was transformed with just a little bit of paint and creativity! 

Follow along for more easy DIY Reno ideas! 💡 

............................................................................

👋 Hi! I’m Stacey, a creative soul who is addicted to DIY 🔨💗
You will most often see me renovating my old fixer upper home on a budget, whether I’m transforming entire rooms, creating decor dupes, flipping furniture or learning to use new power tools, I am constantly working on bringing the daydreams in my head to life ⛅
You won’t see perfection here, in fact, you’re more likely to see me mess up and try again, but I am here to prove with a little hard work and creativity you can create magical things ✨

............................................................................

These products are popular for their dual benefits of adding color while ensuring lip care in sunny conditions.

A Prefeitura de Pedro Leopoldo disponibiliza a Carteira de Identificação da Pessoa com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (CIPTEA), um documento essencial para garantir prioridade no atendimento em diversos serviços públicos e privados. Com a CIPTEA, pessoas autistas podem ter atendimento preferencial em hospitais, clínicas, escolas, universidades, supermercados, farmácias, bancos e lojas.

Quem pode solicitar?

A carteira pode ser solicitada pela própria pessoa com TEA ou por seu responsável legal.

Onde solicitar?

O documento deve ser requerido na Secretaria Municipal de Desenvolvimento Social, localizada na Rua Francisco Bahia, nº 182 – Centro, Pedro Leopoldo. O atendimento ocorre de segunda a sexta-feira, das 12h às 17h. É necessário agendar previamente pelo telefone (31) 98947-0384.

Documentos necessários

Para solicitar a CIPTEA, é preciso apresentar:
✅ 2 fotos 3x4
✅ Identidade e CPF do autista
✅ Comprovante de endereço
✅ Comprovante de tipo sanguíneo
✅ Laudo médico com CID, assinado por psiquiatra ou neurologista
✅ Identidade, CPF e comprovante de endereço dos pais ou responsáveis

Entrega e validade

Após a aprovação do cadastro, a CIPTEA é entregue em até 30 dias úteis. O documento tem validade de 5 anos e é reconhecido em todo o território nacional. A emissão é gratuita para os beneficiários.

A iniciativa reforça o compromisso da Prefeitura com a inclusão e os direitos das pessoas autistas, garantindo mais acessibilidade e respeito no dia a dia.

पंजाब पुलिस की 'Insta Queen' हेरोइन के साथ हुई गिरफ्तार, देखिए वायरल वीडियो || SHORTS || VIRAL || REELS || TREND
#AmandeepKaur #drugsmuggling #AmandeepKaurheroincase #AmandeepKaurreels #arrested #heroin #Punjabpolicewoman #instagramid #constablebathinda #amandeepkaurconstable #ViralReel #shortsviral #youtubeshorts #Youtubeshortsviral #youtubeshortsindia #trendingreelsvideo #trendingreels #trendingpost #trendingnow

¡Diii Viii Nooo!
Esta pasta realmente me sorprendió demasiado… no dejen de hacerla, eso si porfa sigan las instrucciones al pie de la letra.
Ingredientes:
 200 gr de Spaghetti # 12 de @pastaconzazoni
🍋 1 Limón amarillo (ralladura y zumo)
🍋 2 Cucharadas de esparcible Canola Life 
🍋 2 Cucharadas de aceite de oliva
🍋 1 diente de ajo en láminas
🍋 1/3 de cucucharadita de Red Pepper
🍋 1 taza de agua de la cocción de la pasta
🍋 3/4 de taza de queso parmesano
🍋 Albahaca Genovesa fresca
Preparación:
Lo primero será que tengamos todos nuestros ingredientes medidos y listos ya que es una pasta que se prepara muy rápidamente.
Vamos a poner a cocer nuestros Spaghetti de @pastaconzazoni en suficiente agua con sal durante cinco minutos
Aparte vamos a poner a sofreír el ajo junto con el Red Pepper y el aceite de oliva a fuego medio por 1 minuto y agregamos la pasta, la esparcible de Canola Life, la ralladura de limón, el zumo y la taza de agua donde se cocinó la pasta
Vamos a mezclar permanentemente a fuego alto y vamos a esperar que nuestra pasta esté en el punto que la queremos.
Cuando esté lista vamos a apagar el fuego y agregamos inmediatamente el queso parmesano y la albahaca genovesa… seguimos mezclando hasta que nos quede una pasta cremosa y estamos listos para servir.
¡se debe servir caliente!

Sebelum bilang “I do,” pastikan kamu dan pasangan udah bahas ini biar nggak ada drama di masa depan!

1️⃣ “Kita punya visi yang sama nggak?”
Nikah bukan cuma tentang cinta, tapi juga tentang tujuan hidup. Mau tinggal di mana? Karier dulu atau langsung punya anak? Hal-hal ini harus dikomunikasikan.

2️⃣ “Gimana cara kita mengatur keuangan?”
Masalah uang itu sensitif, tapi penting banget dibahas. Mau pakai sistem keuangan gabungan atau masing-masing? Gimana cara kita nabung dan investasi?

3️⃣ “Gimana kalau kita berantem?”
Semua pasangan pasti ada konfliknya. Tapi yang penting, gimana cara kalian menyelesaikannya? Apakah lebih suka didiamkan dulu atau langsung dibahas?

4️⃣ “Kita punya batasan pribadi nggak?”
Setelah nikah, tetap perlu punya waktu buat diri sendiri. Tapi, batasannya apa? Apakah boleh tetap punya me time atau harus selalu bersama?

5️⃣ “Bagaimana hubungan kita dengan keluarga masing-masing?”
Setiap keluarga punya budaya dan kebiasaannya sendiri. Apakah ada ekspektasi tinggal bareng orang tua? Seberapa sering harus kumpul keluarga?

Nikah bukan soal sempurna atau nggaknya pasangan, tapi gimana kalian bisa tumbuh dan berkembang bareng. Jangan sampai hal-hal ini jadi bom waktu di masa depan!
